instruction: Mark all emails in the Drafts folder with a star

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 7) = (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 7));

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding stars to all emails in the Drafts folder (folderID=7). The evaluator checks if at least one message has the 'star' attribute (attributeID=58) set to 1 in the Drafts folder. Verified from database: Drafts folder (folderID=7) contains 7 emails, attributeID 58 corresponds to 'star' status.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails in Drafts folder are starred
Logic: Compares count of all messages (folderID=7) with count of starred messages (attributeID=58, value=1) in the same folder
Query returns 1 only when counts are equal, meaning every email has been starred
If any email is not starred, the counts will differ and query returns 0
The evaluator correctly uses equality comparison (=) between total message count and starred message count
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird and includes sleep to ensure database state is persisted
The expected.type='rule' is handled correctly by run_sqlite3 metric which receives rules dict directly

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
